body: Teach the ft_ surface (ft_infer/ft_profile/ft_validate_text/ft_validate) and the profile→schema→validate flow in the community-extensions description.yml (extended_description + hello_world) at the NEXT community publish — once a release ships these verbs. Deferred here because the live v0.6.22 submission must not document unshipped functions. Use only verified examples (jane.doe@company.co.uk→identity.person.email; ft_validate over a loaded table).

Ship v0.6.23 release carrying the ft_ table-verb surface: version bump (Cargo.toml/lock, configure/extension_version.txt, doc stamps), CHANGELOG 0.6.23 section, tag+GitHub release, then duckdb/community-extensions republish PR at v0.6.23 with ft_ description.yml.
